the local cursor aggregate is sixteen bytes of which only the first two words are written; the collect loop reads the second, third and fourth words, so two of the three pushes read uninitialised stack in the native. The model keeps the same aggregate, writes only the two words the native writes, and the model test asserts only the parts that are determined
the emptiness test compares the cursor against the painter slot end sentinel, which is the owner word advanced by the slot count times four; the model spells the same address arithmetic
the argument gate tests only the low byte, so an argument of 0x00000100 takes the early return; the model reproduces the byte test and the model test uses 0x01
the three property keys share the same numeric constants with the element vtable keys used by 0x00519640, but they are reached through a different seam, so the two are kept as separate ports
the reference bump is a LOCK XADD in the native; the model uses a plain increment, which is equivalent single threaded and is recorded here as a deliberate simplification

cursor_triple_repairs.claim: the cursor triple base comes from the slot value, not from the address of a local quad
cursor_triple_repairs.evidence: 0x0051ac61 MOV EAX,[EBP-0x8] loads the value written at 0x0051ac01, which is the dereferenced slot word, and 0x0051ac6d MOV EAX,[EDX+ECX*0x4+0x4] indexes it with an offset of four plus four times the loop index; the address is only used for the emptiness compare at 0x0051ac3c
cursor_triple_repairs.uninitialised_read: the loop tests and passes slot value plus 4, plus 8 and plus 12, so the upper two entries are whatever the slot object itself holds; the local OpaqueCursorQuad words at offsets 8 and 0xc are never initialised and are not what the target reads
cursor_triple_repairs.fix: the model binds entries to the slot value and indexes entries[i+1], and the model test asserts both collected addresses are the slot value plus four and plus eight
